How it works

Create. Integrate. Launch.

Create a quiz, connect your tools, and launch it on your website to start converting visitors.

Create & Design

Launch & Grow

Embed your quiz on any website and track results to improve conversions over time.

The Quizell way

  • AI-generated quizzes in seconds

Security

Quizell is secure, reliable, and built to scale

Customer data, high-intent leads, and critical business logic are protected from day one. Learn more in our Trust Center

ISO 27001:2022
GDPR Compliant
CCPA

GDPR & CCPA-ready privacy controls

Privacy-by-design data practices aligned with GDPR and CCPA, including retention controls, access rights, and data deletion.

Encryption at rest and in transit

All customer data is encrypted in storage and during transmission, with controlled access and secure key management.

SSO, 2FA & strong access controls

Secure authentication with single sign-on (SSO), two-factor authentication (2FA), role-based access, and regular access reviews.

Secure development & testing

Secure development lifecycle aligned with ISO 27001, including change management, patching, and vulnerability mitigation.

Error handling & recovery

Defined incident response processes, error detection, and recovery mechanisms designed for stability and resilience.

End-to-end observability

Full visibility across systems with audit logs, monitoring, and real-time alerts to detect and respond to issues quickly.
